headline: F1 AT overview-52km-island IS NOT-CAPTURED, NOT A FAIL. The earlier FAIL verdict is WITHDRAWN.

theWithdrawal.whatWasRecorded: T007 recorded F1 FAIL at this station from attempt 3 (p50 16.8, p95 25.2, n=621).
theWithdrawal.whyItIsWithdrawn: That capture carries landing {landed:false, dispatchCount:12}. The campaign's own pre-registration classifies a LANDING FAILURE as an instrument-failure abort that writes no verdict and repeats. A verdict was written from it anyway, and the landing failure was not disclosed. That is the error, and it is mine.
theWithdrawal.reRun: Attempt 4 re-ran the registered instrument at every station. The landing failure REPRODUCED at this station and only this station: landed false, dispatchCount 12 again, while the other four landed on dispatch 1 in both attempts.
theWithdrawal.consequence: A station that will not land cannot yield an F1 verdict under the registered rule. It is NOT-CAPTURED in both attempts, and F1 as an every-station gate therefore has no FAIL to report -- it has four PASSes and one station it could not measure.

readings.noteOnTheNumbers: p50 moved 16.8 to 16.7 between attempts -- across the bar -- while p95 held at 25.2. A tenth of a millisecond that changes a verdict is noise, not a measurement.

twoTierBaselineAtTheSameStation.statement: THE TWO-TIER CITY WAS ALREADY AT THE BAR HERE, BEFORE THE FAR TIER EXISTED: p50 16.7 against a 16.7 bar, p95 24.9 against 25. This station was marginal without the far tier, and any attribution of a 0.1-0.3 ms movement to the far tier has to reckon with that first.

isolationAttempt.instrument: scripts/station-arm-frames-cli.mjs, NEW for this correction. Samples one station under a caller-chosen URL so the far tier can be switched, which the committed frames harness cannot do.
isolationAttempt.refusalRulesFixedBeforeTheArmsRan: Focus is REPORTED, not a refusal, because the registered F1 instrument does not gate on it and both Chromes launch with --disable-renderer-backgrounding. COMPOSITION is a refusal, because the pre-registration requires expected tier composition to be verified by DOM read.

isolationAttempt.whyTheOnArmCouldNotBeCaptured: At this pose the far tier had not finished DECLARING within F1's registered 45 s settle: it read 0 declared cells while the massing layer drew ~42,000 buildings. A 200 s pre-warm brought it to 840 declared / 839 drawn, but the sampler's own Page.navigate resets the page and the tier must re-declare, so the settle the bar registers is not enough here. Three ON attempts, all refused on composition.
isolationAttempt.verdict: ISOLATION INCOMPLETE. The OFF arm captured cleanly and PASSES (p50 16.6, p95 18.2, n=796, far tier wholly disarmed). No valid ON arm exists from the same instrument, so there is no controlled pair.
isolationAttempt.whatMayNotBeConcluded: The OFF arm's 18.2 ms p95 may NOT be differenced against the committed harness's 25.2: different instruments, different sessions, and the harness's own reading never landed. That comparison is suggestive and is not an isolation.

attribution.statement: NOT ISOLATED. T007 does not attribute this station's frame time to the far tier.
attribution.basis: Three reasons together: the station never landed in either attempt; the two-tier baseline was already at 16.7 / 24.9 before the far tier existed; and the ON arm of the isolation could not be captured.
attribution.whatWasSaidBefore: Earlier T007 records called this 'the far tier's'. That attribution is WITHDRAWN wherever it appeared -- campaign summary, ADR 0058, implementation record.

attemptDisclosure: Registered instrument: attempts 3 and 4, both disclosed, both landing-failed at this station. Isolation instrument: one OFF arm captured, three ON arms refused on composition. No reading was discarded for its numbers; every refusal names a precondition.
